name: Tiny Object Detection Challenge
description: The 1st Tiny Object Detection (TOD) Challenge aims to encourage research in developing novel and accurate methods for tiny object detection in images which have wide views, with a current focus on tiny person detection. The TinyPerson dataset was used for the TOD Challenge and is publicly released. It has 1610 images and 72651 box-levelannotations. Around 36 participating teams from the globe competed inthe 1st TOD Challenge. In this paper, we provide a brief summary of the1st TOD Challenge including brief introductions to the top three methods.The submission leaderboard will be reopened for researchers that areinterested in the TOD challenge. The benchmark dataset and other information can be found at: https://github.com/ucas-vg/TinyBenchmark.
reputation: A specialized challenge benchmark for tiny object detection that has seen use in the computer vision community, especially around TinyPerson-style evaluation.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; performance is highly dataset- and scale-dependent, and tiny-object detection remains difficult due to severe size, occlusion, and resolution challenges.
